question: In a code language, 'FORK' is coded as 'GLWD' and 'CAVF' is coded as 'DXAY'. How will 'TRHA' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'FORK' is coded as 'GLWD'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f652050327e6eed1e2589e440c36e8c25094d4f58ba38a82b24e924a02343a77.png] 

'CAVF' is coded as 'DXAY'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4341a19946831142b186492a7636ce1589690d7fd8f2967792404fdab4a59e5a.png] 

Similarly,

 'TRHA' is coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e886835b7bf45f87a1f65a40498b8641633b95cbc5f843395b47ba1d6fb3db62.png] 

Thus, 'TRHA' is coded as 'UOMT'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
